findings: `learner.overview.text` cites X-e04dfa01cf4e0d166657 for a claim that source does not support: it describes four accumulated strokes as the Shang numeral form 亖, not as “Shang 亖” itself. Cite X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4 for that distinction. The overview is also under 45 words, so clarify that this is an attested numeral account while the origin of later 四 remains disputed.
